Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/7/Text/8] At T1 and T2, the adolescents reported their positive afect, negative afect, and life satisfaction, which were the conceptualizations of SWB proposed by Diener et al. (1999). The Positive and Negative Afect Schedule (PANAS, Watson et al. 1988), which was used to estimate the adolescents' afect, contains two subscales: a positive afect scale (PAS) and a negative afect scale (NAS).[/page/8/Text/3] Life satisfaction was measured with the Satisfaction with Life Scale (SWLS; Diener et al. 1985)
